Subject: Quick sync: demo timing and exec windows (CTO + VP)

Hi Alex / Jordan —

Thanks again for booking time with us next week. We want to make sure your CTO and VP can join the most relevant portion of the walkthrough. Current plan: 60-minute technical demo + Q&A (we scheduled 11:00–12:00 PT).

Two constraints just came up on our side: your CTO indicated a tight 30-minute corridor (11:20–11:50 PT) and your VP can only join at the tail end (11:40–12:10 PT). To keep execs engaged and make best use of their overlapping availability, would you consider a compressed 35-minute exec-focused segment 11:20–11:55 PT followed by a separate 25-minute deep-dive for the product/engineering stakeholders?

Proposed breakdown if that works: 
- 11:20–11:55 PT — Executive corridor: value, architecture overview, key integration points, high-level performance numbers, reserve 5 mins for exec Qs.
- 12:05–12:30 PT — Technical deep-dive for engineers with demos of batching, telemetry, and latency tuning.

We can record both segments and share a single recording if you prefer one consolidated file. If splitting feels disruptive, we can also keep a single session but front-load the exec-facing material to 11:20–11:40 and then hand off to Ben for the technical walkthrough.

I attached an updated invite option and a short sponsor brief (sponsor-brief.pdf) that outlines the condensed agenda and who should attend each portion. If you confirm, I’ll send updated invites and a HubSpot note for the deal.

Thanks,
Irene
